name: albis-aipassport-homework
description: AI Passport homework helper for DeepSeek Harness: turns homework screenshots into a checklist on the AI Passport device, with push-to-talk and per-task timers. AI Passport 作业助手。
author: albis

releaseNotes.zh:
### 修复
- **设置项终于能看到了**：“设置 → 插件 → 作业助手”里以前只有一片空白——插件没声明 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 这个依赖，用本地目录（`link:`）安装时取不到它，设置表单就没被生成出来。现在补上依赖，端口、年级、语音识别方式、DeepSeek API Key 都能在设置里改。
- 取不到设置组件时会在日志里明说，不再静默降级。
releaseNotes.en:
### Fixed
- **Plugin settings were invisible**: the “Settings → Plugins → Homework helper” form came up empty, because the plugin never declared the `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` dependency — with a `link:` install it could not be resolved, so no form was generated. The dependency is declared now: port, grade, speech-recognition mode and the DeepSeek API key are all editable in settings.
- A missing settings schema is now logged instead of silently ignored.

releaseNotes.zh:
### 新功能
- **手动加的作业也会判学科和类型**：在家长后台手打“语文课后预习”，添加时就自动归到“语文 / 预习”，不用事后改；模型不可用时按关键词兜底。没填分钟数就用这类作业的历史平均用时。
- **语音识别多了一个云端选项**：设置里的 `asrProvider` 可以选 `sensevoice`（本机模型，默认，录音不出这台电脑）或 `deepseek`（云端识别，快、不占 230MB，但要填 API Key）。选了云端又没填 Key 时，插件自动退回本机模型，并在插件页提醒。
### 需要你知道
- 云端识别要一个 DeepSeek API Key：填在设置里的 `speechKey`（platform.deepseek.com 建一个）。留空会找 Harness 凭据 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`、环境变量；都没有就继续用本机模型。
- 机器人的声音没变，还是原来的机械哔嘟声。
- 只改插件，设备固件不用重刷。
releaseNotes.en:
### New
- **Homework you add by hand is now classified too**: type "语文课后预习" in the parent console and it lands in Chinese / preview straight away; keyword rules take over when the model is unavailable. Leave the minutes empty to use the average for that task type.
- **Speech recognition now has a cloud option**: set `asrProvider` to `sensevoice` (local model, the default — recordings never leave this computer) or `deepseek` (cloud transcription: fast, no 230 MB model, but needs an API key). Pick cloud without a key and the plugin falls back to the local model and says so on its page.
### Please note
- Cloud recognition needs a DeepSeek API key in the `speechKey` setting (create one at platform.deepseek.com). Left empty, the plugin looks for the Harness credential `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, then the environment; otherwise it keeps using the local model.
- The robot's voice is unchanged (the local buzzy chirp).
- Plugin only; no firmware re-flash needed.

releaseNotes.zh:
### 新功能
- **手动加的作业也会自动分类**：在家长后台手写一项作业（例如「语文课后预习」），AI 会判断学科和作业类型，不再全落到「其他」。类型用来统计这类作业平时要做多久；没自己填分钟数时，按这类作业的历史用时给时长。
- **添加时有反馈**：识别期间按钮显示「识别中…」，失败会在下方提示，不会悄悄什么都没发生。
### 说明
- 只改网页后台，设备固件不用重刷。
releaseNotes.en:
### New
- **Manual entries get classified too**: typing an item in the parent page (e.g. 语文课后预习) now lets the AI decide the subject and the task type instead of dumping everything into 其他. The type feeds the per-type duration stats, and when the parent leaves the minutes blank the learned duration for that type is used.
- **Feedback while adding**: the button shows 识别中… while it works, and failures are reported under the row instead of silently doing nothing.
### Notes
- Parent page only; no firmware re-flash needed.

releaseNotes.zh:
### 变化
- **更省电的屏幕**：倒计时页不再空转重绘；长标题只滚动 8 秒后停成“…”，不再一直滚动。
- **背光分三档**：按键或有新事件后 20 秒内最亮，之后 60%，5 分钟没操作降到 30%；倒计时进行中保持 60%。屏幕不会熄灭。
### 修复
- 长标题滚动结束后折成两行、压到倒计时时钟的问题。
- 去掉排查耗电时留在固件里的诊断日志。
- 设备固件需要重新烧录（只烧应用，Wi-Fi 配置保留）。
releaseNotes.en:
### Changes
- **Calmer screen**: the countdown page no longer redraws constantly; a long title scrolls for 8 seconds, then stops as "…" instead of scrolling forever.
- **Three-step backlight**: brightest for 20 s after a key press or new event, then 60%, and 30% after 5 minutes idle; a running countdown stays at 60%. The screen never turns off.
### Fixes
- A long title wrapping to two lines and covering the countdown clock after it stopped scrolling.
- Removed the diagnostic logging that was left in the firmware while tracking battery drain.
- The device firmware needs a re-flash (app only; Wi-Fi settings are kept).

releaseNotes.zh:
### 新功能
- **全部完成庆祝**：做完当天最后一项作业，设备上机器人会用清洁滚刷把作业卡片一行行扫掉，撒彩屑庆祝。
- **做完自动清空**：庆祝结束后设备清空列表，显示“今天的作业全部完成啦！”，服务端把当天作业连同实际用时存档。
- **今日作业显示总用时**：后台“今日作业”进度行显示今天已用时多少分钟，清空后仍可查看。
### 变化
- 不再区分必做和选做，当天所有作业都要做完。
- 设备固件需要重新烧录（只烧应用，Wi-Fi 配置保留）。
releaseNotes.en:
### New
- **All-done celebration**: when the last task of the day is finished, the robot on the device sweeps the task cards away with its roller brush and throws confetti.
- **Auto clear**: after the celebration the device clears its list and says all of today's homework is done; the server archives the day with the real time worked.
- **Total time on Today**: the progress line on the Today page shows how many minutes were used today, even after the list is cleared.
### Changes
- No more required vs optional: every task of the day has to be done.
- The device firmware needs a re-flash (app only; Wi-Fi settings are kept).

releaseNotes.zh:
### 新功能
- **设备配对**：设备不再写死电脑名和令牌。开机后自动找到电脑，屏幕显示 4 位配对码，在插件页最上方点“允许”即可连上，所有家庭可用同一份固件。
- **插件更新**：有新版本时，插件页顶部和侧边栏会提示，点“更新”就能装好新版，重启 Harness 生效。
### 修复
- 电脑拒绝设备令牌后，设备会自己重新配对，不用重刷固件。
releaseNotes.en:
### New
- **Device pairing**: no more computer name or token baked into the firmware. The device finds the computer, shows a 4-digit code, and you tap Allow at the top of the plugin page. One firmware works for every household.
- **Plugin updates**: a banner on the plugin page and a badge in the sidebar; tap Update, then restart Harness.
### Fixes
- If the computer refuses the device token, the device pairs again by itself.

releaseNotes.zh: - 第一个版本：作业截图整理成清单、设备上倒计时、按住说话。
releaseNotes.en: - First release: screenshots to a checklist, countdown on the device, push-to-talk.
